how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates must apply through the offline mode as described below.
Download the application form from the official IIP website: https://www.iip-in.com/
Fill in the application form in the prescribed proforma.
Attach all relevant documents and annexures along with the filled application. Applications without relevant annexures will be treated as disqualified.
Place the duly filled application in a sealed envelope, clearly mentioning the post applied for.
Send the sealed envelope to: Additional Director and Regional Officer, IIP-Delhi, Indian Institute of Packaging (IIP), Delhi, Plot No. 21, Patparganj Industrial Area, Delhi-110092.
Ensure the application reaches the above address on or before 22-08-2026. Applications received after the stipulated period will not be considered.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary and on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year, subject to renewal based on performance. The consolidated remuneration will remain unchanged for the term of the contract, with no increment during the contract period, and is subject to deduction of Professional Tax/TDS as applicable. Shortlisted candidates may be required to work on weekends, holidays, or beyond normal working hours without extra remuneration. Candidates appointed cannot represent or advise others in matters adverse to the interest of the office, and cannot take up any other assignment during the contract period. The engagement may be terminated by the office at any time with 30 days' notice, without assigning reasons. If a candidate wishes to leave, they must give 3 months' notice. In cases of unfitness, insubordination, or misconduct, services can be terminated immediately without notice. IIP shall not be responsible for any loss, accident, damage, or injury suffered by candidates arising out of the execution of their work, including travel. IIP reserves the right to fill the advertised posts or otherwise. No correspondence will be entertained regarding postal delays, interview conduct/result, or reasons for not being called for interview. Candidates cannot claim any right to employment in the Institute during or after discontinuation of the contract.

content_sections.heading: IIP Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualification requirements vary by post. Candidates are advised to check the exact requirement for their post of interest below.

rows.qualification: Retired academician from IIT/NIT/other institution of national/international repute; Ph.D. in Packaging Technology, Printing Technology, Textile Technology, Polymer Technology/Material Science, or allied fields from a recognised university/institution. Preference for those with experience in foreign universities.

Mandatory Ph.D. in Management/Business Administration/Allied Discipline with minimum 10 years teaching/research/industry experience; OR an outstanding professional with an established reputation in a relevant corporate field, substantiated by credentials. Retired Professors from IIM/reputed Management Institutes will be considered.
Ph.D. in Management/Allied Discipline with minimum 8 years teaching/research experience. Preference to candidates from IIT/IIM.
MBA/MMS/M.Com/relevant Master's Degree, with NET/Ph.D. preferred.

Good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline; Master's Degree with first class; minimum 8 years of teaching and/or research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor, with NET/GATE and a minimum of 5 publications as books and/or research/policy papers; minimum API score as per UGC norms.

Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Smart Manufacturing, Automation, Packaging Technology, or a related interdisciplinary area preferred, with M.E./M.Tech./M.S. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning/Computer Science/Data Science/Electronics/Automation/Mechatronics/Packaging Technology or allied disciplines.

Ph.D. in Sustainable Packaging, Circular Economy, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Environmental Sustainability, Packaging Materials, Waste Management, or a related interdisciplinary area. Desirable knowledge of LCA software tools such as SimaPro, GaBi, and OpenLCA.

Ph.D. in Packaging Design, Structural Packaging, Industrial Design, Consumer Packaging, Sustainable Packaging Design, or a related interdisciplinary area. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, CAD software, and 3D modelling tools is desirable.

Essential: Ph.D. in Printing Technology, Graphic Design, Packaging Design, Visual Communication, Industrial Design, or a related interdisciplinary area. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, CAD software, and 3D modelling/rendering tools is desirable.

Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in English/Communication Studies/Linguistics/Business Communication/Journalism & Mass Communication or allied disciplines. NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline is desirable.
MBA with specialisation in Marketing or Human Resource Management from a recognised University/Institution.
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised university with proficiency and experience in filing, drafting, typing, documentation, MS Office, and dictation work.
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry/Instrumentation with experience in GC-MS, FT-IR, CHNS Analyzer.
Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognised university.
Minimum 12th Pass with Science. Preference given to ITI certificate holders and candidates with 0-2 years of experience in laboratory assistance.
M.Des in Product/Industrial Design from NID/IITs/reputed institutes/CAD with experience in packaging development.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIP Recruitment 2026 refers to the notification released by Indian Institute of Packaging (IIP) on 28-07-2026 for filling various technical and non-technical posts on a temporary and contractual basis at IIP Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies are specified across 15 posts. The exact number of vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Printing & Graphic Designs) post is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 22-08-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ by post, ranging from a 12th pass for Laboratory Attendant to a Ph.D. for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts. Candidates should refer to the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post and is specified only for some posts, ranging from up to 27 years for Laboratory Attendant to up to 50 years for certain Associate Professor posts. The age limit is not specified for the remaining posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official IIP website, fill it in the prescribed format, attach the required documents, and send it in a sealed envelope to the Additional Director and Regional Officer, IIP-Delhi, on or before 22-08-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting of applications as per qualifications and experience, followed by an interview or a merit-based process as directed by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IIP Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary (proposed consolidated remuneration) ranges from Rs 20,000 per month for Laboratory Attendant to Rs 1,50,000 per month for Professor posts, depending on the position and experience. Refer to the salary table above for post-wise details.
